name: Kingpin

moves.name: Bear Hug
moves.description: Wraps a foe in his arms and squeezes; held foes take crush damage each round until they break free.

moves.name: Palm Strike
moves.description: Sumo open-hand blow that sends a man across the office.

moves.name: Desk Throw
moves.description: Hurls a desk, a safe or a bodyguard at the target.

moves.name: Cane Laser
moves.description: A beam from the obsidian handle; one charge per scene.

moves.name: Sleeping Gas
moves.description: Gas from the cane or stickpin that staggers everyone in reach; one charge per scene.

moves.name: Absorb Blow
moves.description: Takes the hit on his bulk and does not move.

moves.name: Call the Guards
moves.description: Summons armed muscle into the room next round.

moves.name: Send Bullseye
moves.description: Deploys an assassin against the target in the following scene.

moves.name: Buy the Cop
moves.description: Shifts NYPD standing in his favor and against a hero for the arc.

moves.name: Leverage
moves.description: Spends a file to end the confrontation without a fight; the hero leaves.

moves.name: Quiet Word
moves.description: Tells a hero exactly what he knows about their life; lowers their morale for the fight.

leitmotif: Slow, heavy bass ostinato under sparse high piano notes; silence between phrases does the work.
